description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) to allow for marginally enlarging the basement and ground floor extension of 00988/50/P1 approved 03/09/2019 for the erection of a rear roof extension and erection of a basement and ground floor extensions to the rear with internal remodelling to existing house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun 4 September 2022.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (GIA Schedule, received 6 August 2019, and Flood Risk Assessment, Design Statement and Drawings SMG-01, SMG-02, 01, 02, 03 and 04, received 22 January 2019. SMG-03 Rev. B, SMG-04A Rev. B, SMG-05 A Rev. B. Received: 02/12/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9:00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The development shall be implemented in accordance with the Structural Engineering Basement Construction Method Statement  dated September 2019 and the Flood Evacuation Plan dated November 2019 approved as part of planning application 00988/50/P1(5).
Condition : 7 - The basement shall at no time be used or occupied as a separate dwelling independent of the main house and shall not be used as sleeping accommodation.

Condition : 8 - No development shall be carried out until such time as the person carrying out the work is a member of the Considerate Constructors Scheme and its code of practice, and the details of the membership and contact details are clearly displayed on the site so that they can be easily read by members of the public.
